problem.title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.51
problem.statement: It can be shown that there exists a Blaschke product $B(z)$ with \mbox{$B(0) = 0$} such that \[\frac{1+B(z)}{1-B(z)}\] is a Bloch function. Give an explicit construction for such a product. (F. Holland)
